description: Vietnam Solar Resource Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Rachel Fox (World Bank Group). Solar resource, PV power potential and other parameters are provided in the form of raster (gridded) GeoTIFF format. Coverage: Vietnam. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Renewable energy, Solar. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
